nodes.question: Is Shuffle a per-session user toggle on the Today screen, a new global admin setting, or a replacement for the existing mixNewWithDue setting? The ticket does not say where the option lives.
nodes.quote: A Shuffle option for today's review
nodes.answer: mixNewWithDue is an existing global admin setting, validated as a required boolean in the shared admin-settings schema and optional in the update schema. The web admin-settings page has a toggle for mixNewWithDue, and the iOS admin-settings screen also exposes it. Per the earlier research note, mixNewWithDue is stored in the mix_new_with_due column (boolean, not null, default true). When it is false the queue returns due cards followed by new cards. When it is true the queue alternates seen and new cards deterministically, not randomly. Scoped review queues (tag, topic, bit, subject) read the same mixNewWithDue flag. Nothing in the schema or the other code I searched implements shuffle or random ordering for the review queue. The ticket text appears in TODO.md only as a one-line item that says a session is not always new cards first. It does not state where the option lives, and it does not say whether Shuffle replaces mixNewWithDue.

nodes.question: Does 'random order' mean a full random permutation of the combined new and due cards, or randomness only in how new and due are interleaved? The current interleave is deterministic alternation.
nodes.quote: mixes new and due cards in random order
nodes.answer: The current mix is `interleaveNewWithSeen(seen, fresh, limit)`. It alternates one seen (due) card and one new card until the limit is reached or both lists run out. It has no randomness. The interleave is controlled by the admin setting `mixNewWithDue`. That setting is a boolean on/off switch, and the shuffle option would be a separate choice from it. An earlier plan describes the scoped review path. Cards come ordered by reviewCount ascending, then createdAt. With `mixNewWithDue` on, seen and new cards are interleaved via `interleaveNewWithSeen`. Grepping `apps/api/src/knowledge-bit` for shuffle or random found only `randomUUID` in test ids. No existing shuffle or random-order logic is in the review queue code.

Where does Shuffle live: a per-session toggle on the Today screen, a new global admin setting, or a replacement for mixNewWithDue? Nothing I read decides this. It determines whether the work touches the Today screen UI, the admin-settings schema, DB column and API, or the existing mix behaviour.

nodes.question: Should "random order" be a full random permutation of the combined new and due cards, or should it only randomise how new and due are interleaved? The existing interleave is deterministic alternation, and no code or doc settles this. A full permutation would drop the alternating pattern and could put many new cards in a row. Randomised interleaving would keep each pool's internal order, for example due cards most overdue first.
